name: io.github.ljcl/intervals-mcp
description: Remote MCP server for intervals.icu run data and analysis

environmentVariables.name: INTERVALS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: intervals.icu personal API key (Settings, Developer Settings)

environmentVariables.name: INTERVALS_ATHLETE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Athlete id: 0 (default, the API key's own athlete) or e.g. i12345

environmentVariables.name: TZ
environmentVariables.description: IANA time zone for local dates, e.g. Australia/Sydney; unset or UTC follows the athlete's intervals.icu time zone (Etc/UTC pins UTC)

environmentVariables.name: ORS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenRouteService API key (openrouteservice.org) for generated route suggestions; unset offers past runs only

environmentVariables.name: HOME_START
environmentVariables.description: Usual run start as lat,lng (e.g. 37.79,-122.39); unset infers it from recent GPS runs

environmentVariables.name: OSM_EXTRACT_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of an .osm.pbf (e.g. a BBBike city or Geofabrik region) for the local OpenStreetMap index that counts road crossings in route suggestions; needs HOME_START

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret (32+ characters) gating /mcp and detailed /health (recommended when internet-facing)

environmentVariables.name: DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for stored routes (stitch-route, amend-route); the image uses /data, a volume in docker-compose.yml. Default ./data

environmentVariables.name: ROUTE_RETENTION_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days a stored route not read or changed is kept, 1-3650 (default 30)

environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public URL, used only to warn when /mcp is exposed without MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
